description:
In a world where the boundaries between realms blur, Choi Kangwoo and his companions have finally achieved their Awakening, unlocking extraordinary powers. As newly minted heroes, they find themselves thrust into an epic conflict that spans across the mortal world, the divine realms, and the demon realm.

With the fate of multiple world hanging in the balance, Kangwoo's team must navigate treacherous alliances, face off against legendary figures from various mythologies, and master their newfound abilities. As they delve deeper into the war, they uncover a sinister plot that threatens the very fabric of existence.

From summoning ancient beasts to wielding the power of creation itself, our heroes must push their limits and overcome seemingly insurmountable odds. With each battle, they inch closer to uncovering the true nature of their role in this cosmic struggle.

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12084764)
